title: Quizy — a Full-Stack Online Quiz Platform.
description: MERN-based featuring role-based authentication, timed quizzes with auto-save, real-time monitoring using Socket IO  and comprehensive performance tracking. Enabled teachers to create and manage quizzes while allowing students to take assessments and review detailed result history.
technologies: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Auth, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, Axios
